title: Stochastic Nonconvex Bilevel Optimization: Improved Rates Without Rare-Visit Assumption
abstract: arXiv:2609.06580v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate stochastic simple bilevel optimization with smooth and possibly nonconvex upper- and lower-level objectives. Existing stochastic extensions of dynamic barrier gradient descent (DBGD) either obtain fast convergence under an unverifiable trajectory-dependent ``rare-visit'' assumption, or remove this assumption at a substantially higher oracle cost. We show that a simple denominator-only regularization of the DBGD multiplier eliminates the need for such an assumption while preserving fast convergence rates. Specifically, our method achieves $(\varepsilon, \varepsilon)$-stationarity in $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ iterations using $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ upper-level and $O(\varepsilon^{-7})$ lower-level stochastic gradients, which improves upon the best assumption-free complexities. We additionally derive anytime parameter schedules.

translated_title: 随机非凸双层优化：无需稀有访问假设的改进收敛率
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有光滑且可能非凸的上层和下层目标的随机简单双层优化问题。现有的动态障碍梯度下降（DBGD）的随机扩展方法，要么在不可验证的依赖于轨迹的“稀有访问”假设下获得快速收敛，要么以显著更高的oracle代价移除该假设。我们证明，对DBGD乘子进行简单的仅分母正则化即可消除对这类假设的需要，同时保持快速收敛率。具体而言，我们的方法在 $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 次迭代中达到 $(\varepsilon, \varepsilon)$-平稳性，仅需 $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ 次上层和 $O(\varepsilon^{-7})$ 次下层随机梯度，这改进了现有最好的无假设复杂度结果。此外，我们还推导了任意时刻适用的参数调度方案。
tldr: 该论文通过对动态障碍梯度下降（DBGD）乘子进行简单的仅分母正则化，在无需“稀有访问”假设的情况下实现了快速收敛，达到了 $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 次迭代的平稳性，并改进了现有最好的无假设复杂度结果。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that a simple denominator-only regularization of the DBGD multiplier eliminates the unverifiable rare-visit assumption while preserving fast convergence, achieving $(\varepsilon,\varepsilon)$-stationarity in $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ iterations and improving the best known assumption-free complexities for stochastic nonconvex bilevel optimization.
